commands.description: List of commands to generate. Each item configures one 'copy' or 'create' invocation. Only one command type per run is typical, but multiple commands may be batched for scripting purposes.

commands[].type.description: Command type: 'copy' or 'create'. Required for each command entry.

commands[].image.description: Source image file path or URL. Use '-' to read from stdin for 'copy' commands.

commands[].dest.description: Destination file or block device path (required for 'copy').

commands[].bmap.description: Explicit path or URL to the bmap file. If omitted, auto-discovery is attempted.

commands[].bmap_sig.description: Path or URL to a detached OpenPGP signature file for the bmap.

commands[].fingerprint.description: Expected GPG fingerprint of the signer (for signature verification).

commands[].keyring.description: Path to a custom GPG keyring file for signature verification.

commands[].nobmap.description: Disable automatic bmap discovery and copy the entire image without bmap.

commands[].no_sig_verify.description: Skip OpenPGP signature verification of the bmap file (not recommended).

commands[].no_verify.description: Skip SHA-256 checksum verification of data (not recommended).

commands[].psplash_pipe.description: Path to a FIFO to which machine-readable progress (psplash format) will be written.

commands[].removable_device.description: Only proceed if destination is a removable block device (e.g., SD card or USB).

commands[].output.description: Output file path for the generated bmap (for 'create' command). If omitted, write to stdout.

commands[].no_checksum.description: Generate bmap without SHA-256 checksums (not recommended).
